definition: the one signal my body gives me when a resource is running out

settled:
It is not wanting to, and it says a bar is low without saying which one.

My four bars do not surface as four readings. They all come through as this one signal.

So I work out which bar it is afterwards, by matching what I feel now against each bar's signature. Jitteriness from cortisol is health. A drop in what I can start that is global rather than about the one task in front of me is mana. Plain fatigue is stamina. For safety I walk down the activity tiers until one holds.

That reading is what feeds the rule about not doing what I cannot afford.

title: Not Wanting To Is The Gauge
